messages:
Ava: dropping the launch blog draft into CMS now. includes webinar CTA and a short benchmark blurb. https://cms.redwood.ai/entries/1841234567-launch-draft — please review headers, CTAs, and lead routing before EOD Wed.
Riley: on it. can you also link the webinar registration page and promo deck?
Ava: webinar page is here: https://events.redwood.ai/register?event=april-launch. deck in Drive: /Marketing/Launch/Deck_v3.pdf
Priya: glanced at the benchmark sentence: it currently says '30% cheaper on average' 1 legal will want qualifiers. suggest: 'Observed up to 30% lower token cost in internal benchmark workloads (methodology linked).'
LegalBot: request: avoid absolute claims without context. please add the methodology link or phrase 'in internal benchmarks on representative workloads' and add the PDF to the CMS entry.
Sam: fine with that phrasing. also recommend we add a short footnote with the benchmark caveats and a link.
Ava: updated line to: "Observed up to 30% lower token cost in internal benchmarks on representative workloads. Methodology: [PDF]." will attach PDF to CMS.
DesignBot: quick design note: hero image crops oddly at 375px width. I'll push a small crop fix and add alt text: 'Redwood platform dashboard on laptop'.
Riley: CTA copy options: 1) Register for webinar 2) Get launch trial credits 3) See benchmarks. Which should be primary?
Sam: primary CTA should be webinar registration for first 72 hours, secondary 'Get trial credits'. We want signups early.
Ops: FYI for publish timing: we can do Thu 10:00am PT. Need final assets and final URL routing by Wed 5:00pm PT to coordinate CDN invalidation and analytics.
Ava: noted. final assets deadline Wed 5:00pm PT. I'm on attaching PDF and updating CTAs.
SalesBot: for inbound routing, please set HubSpot form hidden field: campaign=launch_apr_2024 and lead_owner_rule: SDR-queue-APAC if utm_region=apac. Also map utm_campaign and utm_source to contact properties.
Priya: will add UTM examples in the copy checklist: ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_apr&utm_medium=organic
LegalBot: approved copy with the benchmark wording and methodology link. keep the footnote language exactly as: "Observed up to 30% lower token cost in internal benchmarks on representative workloads. Methodology available in attached PDF."
Ava: thanks Legal. I'll lock that sentence in CMS.
Riley: marketing approves the hero, CTAs, and routing. I'll add UTM examples to the CMS meta and patch the HubSpot form mapping with SalesOps.
DesignBot: crop fix pushed to staging at 1841234722. alt text added in CMS.
Ava: publishing plan: create social snippets on Thurs 9:30am PT, publish blog 10:00am PT, email to webinar list 10:15am PT. ops confirm CDN/analytics ready?
Ops: confirmed. analytics tags and CDN invalidation scheduled for 10:00:30am PT.
Ava: TODO list:
- attach benchmark PDF to CMS (Ava)
- push final assets and hero image (DesignBot)
- HubSpot form mapping + hidden fields (Riley/SalesOps)
- set UTMs in CMS meta (Priya)
- schedule publish (Ops)
Final: will reconvene if anything blocks. thanks all :tada:
